verdict: NUANCED CONFIRMATION: speak-from-day-one maximizes PRODUCTION at 60d (0.90, best) but is NOT best for COMPREHENSION at 7d (0.55 vs input-only 0.80). Silent-period studies (Postovsky/Gary) explain why: early output without feedback risks fossilization + affective-filter spike (Krashen), while pushed output WITH feedback triggers Swain noticing/testing/reflection. Prescription matches evidence synthesis: week-1 say studied sentences aloud + few own sentences; most hours still input; add partner who forces self-correction once short exchanges possible (second-language.app 2026-02-05 protocol).
falsifiable_prediction: A 4-arm 60-day RCT (n>=40/arm) will rank production: speak+feedback > balanced > output-only > input-only; and 7-day comprehension reversed.
